title: Warranty and Claims Statement for Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes
content:
The mill warrants what the programme's guarantee says it warrants, which on a bagged programme is the analysis on the tag and on a formula programme is that the mix was run to the specification on file.

## Short loads

A short load is credited where the weight difference between the mill scale and the member's scale is outside the programme's weight tolerance, and a difference inside the tolerance is not a claim.

## Feed coming back

Feed comes back only where the programme's returnable classes cover it and only inside the return window counted in calendar days from the delivery date, a return offered on the final day still being in time. Medicated feed is never returnable on any programme, because it cannot go back into the bin.

The window is read from the mill's own record of the load: the date it was delivered, the ticket it went out on, the invoice it was billed on and the class of feed it was. The ticket and the invoice together are what tie a return to the load it concerns.

*Hypothetical.* A load delivered on the fourth of a month on a programme whose return window is three calendar days may still be offered back on the seventh, which is the final day, and stands outside the window on the eighth.

## How a credit is written

A credit is written against the invoice the load was billed on and never against the account as a whole, so two short loads make two credits.

## Where the ration is said to have caused a problem in the herd

Where the member believes the ration caused a performance problem in the herd, the mill will pull the retained sample and have it analysed, and any settlement beyond the value of the feed is a matter for the cooperative's insurer rather than for any rule here.

## Points of judgement

| The claim | How it reads |
| --- | --- |
| A weight difference between the two scales inside the programme's tolerance | Not a claim |
| A weight difference outside that tolerance | The short load is credited |
| Feed of a class the programme's returnable classes cover, offered back on the final day of the window | In time |
| Feed of a class the programme's returnable classes do not cover | It does not come back |
| Medicated feed, on any programme within the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes | Never returnable |
